cards.text: Friend, Jesus just gave some hard teaching, and a lot of His disciples walked away (John 6:60, 66). After this, Jesus travels throughout Galilee. He stays out of Judea, though, because it isn't safe for Him there.

cards.question: Why isn't Judea safe for Jesus?

answers.text: The Jews there were trying to kill Him
Roman soldiers were out to arrest Him
Herod had sent men to capture Him

cards.text: But the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles is near. So Jesus' brothers tell Him to leave Galilee and go to Judea, and they've got somebody in mind to see what He does there.

cards.question: Jesus' brothers want Him in Judea for the feast. Who do they want to see the works He's doing?

cards.text: Their pitch: nobody who wants to be known acts in secret, so "show Yourself to the world." Friend, they sound like your friends at karaoke night shoving the mic in YOUR hand.

cards.question: Then the writer of this Gospel adds a note about Jesus' brothers. True or false: His own brothers believed in Him.

cards.text: Jesus answers His brothers, and He talks about timing. He tells them His time has not yet come.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells His brothers that their time is always at hand.
Jesus tells His brothers the world can't hate them, but it hates Him. Why does He say it hates Him?

answers.text: He testifies that its works are evil
He takes its crowds away from it

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them, "Go up to the feast on your own." He says He's not going up to this feast, and He stays behind in Galilee.

cards.question: Once His brothers have gone up to the feast, Jesus goes up too. How does He go?

answers.text: Riding in on a young donkey

cards.text: So at the feast, the Jews are looking for Him and asking, "Where is He?" Friend, I know that hunt, because that's me looking for my rolling pin before every single batch.

cards.question: Many in the crowds at the feast have something to say about Jesus. Some say, "He is a good man." What do others reply?
True or false: At the feast, people talk about Jesus out in the open.

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Keep that oven warm, because this feast is just getting started.
